name: Mount Maunganui Beach Reef ("Mount Reef")

confidence.reason: The outline is the -2.0 m Chart Datum contour of the 18 Jul 2013 multibeam survey (BoPRC Fig 3, NZ-grid ticks, 5.45 px/m), confirmed by a second raster of the same survey (area 1,074 vs 1,072 m2, IoU 0.93) and by a 0.125 m 2010-11 aerial (position within 2 m), so the arm angles, bag lengths and position are well fixed; but it is a lower-bound footprint (67.9 x 60.4 m, 1,071 m2; as-built toe 73.9 x 62.5 m, 1,424 m2) that is 8-15 % smaller than the 80 x 70 m in the BoPRC text, the survey is 5 years after completion (apex bags deflated, small north-arm base bags most likely buried), and the area depends on the outline definition (1,071 to 1,723 m2).
factors: georeferenced multibeam plan (NZ-grid ticks, 5.45 px/m); tick pixels, area, bbox and canonical frame re-computed by the verifier (identical)
second raster of the same survey (BoPRC Fig 5, own ticks and colour bar): depth < -2.0 m mask 1,074 m2 vs 1,072 m2, IoU 0.93, zero shift
structure clearly visible on the LINZ 2010-11 0.125 m aerial; survey outline agrees to about 2 m (0.5 m W, 1.75-2.0 m S, two independent tests)
primary outline 14-15 % below the text (80 x 70 m) and the as-built toe 8-11 % below: rubric medium band; no measurement of the structure reaches 80 x 70 m (survey 67-74 x 60-65 m)

footprint definition spread: -2.0 m contour 1,071 m2; 0.3-0.5 m above the 2013 bed 1,050-1,250 m2; as-built toe 1,424 m2; aerial dark mass 1,723 m2 (upper bound); Scarfe 2008 reef area 2,400 m2 (70 % complete, definition not stated)
survey is July 2013, not the as-built state: apex bags deflated (-2.0 to -2.4 m CD, outside the outline), small north-arm base bags most likely buried (BoPRC inference)
toe-level outline: scale from a registration (+-6 %; the axis ticks would give 6.27 px/m, 5 % higher), volume check 2,835-2,861 vs 2,800 m3
survey chosen over the aerial as primary (departs from the rubric order): justified, the reef lies under 3-4.5 m of water so aerial edges are soft (+-1.5-2 m)
Gemini footprint rejected (wrong site, design-stage schematic)

design_version.drawn: As-built bag field of the completed reef (construction finished mid-2008): img1 outlines the large bags at the -2.0 m CD contour as surveyed 18 Jul 2013; the as-built toe-level outline (ASR image, after Aug 2008) is given separately as toe_polygons_m. State drawn is the built delta-wing "7": west (northern) arm of three bags + a top-row bag, south (long) arm of two bags, and two NE "focus" bags.
design_version.why_this_one: The reef was built Nov 2005 - mid 2008 to the 2005 delta-wing consent, never to the original 50 x 100 m wedge or the symmetric 70 x 30 m V. No as-built plan with a scale exists in accessible sources, so the 2013 georeferenced multibeam is the measured source (BoPRC: crest levels of the main bags "have not changed significantly" since 2008) and the ASR post-construction image shows the completed state. Later changes are notes: apex bag deflation (2008, worse by 2013), north-arm base bags most likely buried by 2013 (BoPRC inference), partial removal started 25 Sep 2014 and was finished over the weekend of 8-9 Nov 2014 (SunLive, posted 10 Nov 2014: all bags above the seabed removed), five-year consent lapsed (2010 per NZ Herald; BoPRC gives no year), fabric washing ashore Jan 2023. VERIFIER 2026-10-06: the survey (as-built bag field, 2013) was kept as primary although the rubric lists georeferenced imagery first: the LINZ aerial is georeferenced and shows the reef, but under 3-4.5 m of water its edges are soft (1.5-2 m) and give no depth-defined outline, so it is used as the position/size check (agreement 2 m; visible mass 71.3 x 64.9 m, 1,723 m2 upper bound). Page wording: the drawing is the as-built reef as measured in July 2013; the reef was removed in Sep-Nov 2014.

sources.match_notes: Outline follows the red/orange bag fields and the black -2 contour line (overlays/img1_boprc_fig3_2013.png). It is a mid-height (about half-relief) outline: the bag sides are near vertical on the north side (0.5 m red -> green) and less steep on the scour side (1-1.5 m), so the true toe lies ~0.3-1.5 m outside it. outline_versions.name: Multibeam survey outline (-2.0 m CD, 18 Jul 2013)
outline_versions.method: Outline of the -2.0 m Chart Datum contour on the georeferenced BoPRC Fig 3 (University of Waikato / Discovery Marine Ltd multibeam), re-checked on Fig 5 (IoU 0.93).
outline_versions.level: -2.0 m CD contour of the 2013 DEM = the exposed (mid-height) outline of the large bags; a lower bound of the footprint, the bags continue below it to the seabed
outline_versions.note: Survey is 5 years after completion (apex bags deflated, small north-arm base bags probably buried). The 3D model lofts the as-built reef from this contour: crest at -0.9 m CD, 1:1 skirt from the contour to the seabed (assumption).

outline_versions.name: As-built toe outline (ASR 'Installed' survey image, 2008)
outline_versions.method: Toe-level outline of the colour-coded 'Mount Reef Installed' bathymetry (ASR, on Raised Water Research) registered onto Fig 3 (scale +-6 %).
outline_versions.level: base (toe) of the bags as built, before settlement and burial; includes the north-side base bags, the east-side bag of the south arm and the junction fill that are buried or below -2.0 m in 2013
outline_versions.note: Datum of the Installed image not stated (read as MVD-53); scale from registration. The 3D model lofts from the toe at the seabed through the -2.0 m contour of the 2013 survey to the crest.

versions_info: Two outlines of the same built reef are stored. DEFAULT: the -2.0 m Chart Datum contour of the 18 Jul 2013 multibeam survey (BoPRC Fig 3; 1,071 m2, 67.9 x 60.4 m), the best measured edge but a mid-height, lower-bound footprint measured 5 years after completion. SECOND: the as-built toe outline read from the ASR 'Installed' survey image (2008; 1,424 m2, 73.9 x 62.5 m), registered onto the 2013 survey, which includes bags that are buried or below -2.0 m by 2013. A third footprint, the dark mass on the 2010-11 aerial (about 1,723 m2), is kept only as an area (optional, not drawn).

outline_versions_optional.note: Not stored as a polygon and not built in 3D (Lior 2026-10-06): the dark mass includes shadow and scour-hole darkening, so only its area is kept as an upper bound (threshold +-2 units gives 1,308-2,073 m2).
